speaker: Doctor
text: The normal sulfonylurea level rules out that specific cause, but the severe hypoglycemia in a post-bariatric surgery patient with a history of suicide attempts suggests either a rare toxic ingestion or a surgical complication like dumping syndrome exacerbated by malnutrition. DIAGNOSIS READY: Factitious hypoglycemia due to intentional insulin or sulfonylurea ingestion (despite negative screen, clinical picture fits best)
